title: Raw Deal With Fetzer, Hagopian and Winter
text:
We dodged a bullet when Trump did not announce an attack on Iran during his State of the Union address. Reports have it that the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff informed him that the US was not able to conduct the war he had in mind because we had given so much of our equipment (including missiles) to Israel, on the one hand, and to Ukraine, on the other.
A look into the USS Gerald R Shitstorm situation, sabotaged?
New reports that UK and France want to give Ukraine one or more nukes to give it “leverage” in negotiations with Russia, where Medvedev has declared that, were this to happen, Russia would nuke all three. Serious stuff. Pepe Escobar reports that Israel sent an F-35 with a nuke to create an EMP blast to neutralize Iran’s missiles but that Russia intervened and shot it down.
Look for a false flag attack between now and Monday, which is Purim, a Jewish holiday honoring Queen Esther for revealing her Jewish identity to save the Jews from slaughter by the Persians (today’s Iran).
